# Ninja Adventure Asset Pack

Used in this project (Stage A: player character and farm tools).

- Source: https://pixel-boy.itch.io/ninja-adventure-asset-pack
- Authors: Pixel-boy, AAA
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal (see LICENSE.txt in this folder)
- Attribution not required but appreciated.

Copied characters: Actor/Character/Villager3 (player walk/idle/attack frames).
Copied tools: Items/Tool/{Hoe,Axe,Pickaxe,Sickle,WateringCan}.png (scaled ×4 nearest-neighbor).

## Stage D — inventory / hotbar icons
